name: Oxyplug Image
author: Oxyplug Team

sections.description: Oxyplug Image is a WordPress.org plugin that optimize your site by compressing your images, creating 1X, 2X, 2.8X and 3x images, creating webp/avif and also preload featured images to improve the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and to get a better Core Web Vital (CWV) score on Google’s Lighthouse.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Oxyplug Image.
  3. Install and activate the Oxyplug Image plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire oxyplug-image folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the Oxyplug Image plugin.
